narrative:

This suggests that your academic trajectory may not align with the expectations for success on the bar exam. Additionally, your family income level, categorized as upper-middle, was another contributing factor. While this is a common background among many applicants, it did not provide a strong enough advantage in your case, especially when combined with your academic performance.
